name: Session Pulse
description:
Your Claude Code sessions in the top bar: how many are open, which are working, today's totals and open to-dos, with one click to the dashboard.

Needs the Session Pulse app, which does the work and keeps your data on your machine:
  pipx install sessionpulse
  sessionpulse install --daemon

The extension only reads a small status file the app writes; it makes no network requests and runs no programs.
